source: Written for VPM to the upstream package's API and behavior. Emotion's tests are retained in scripts/emotion-conformance/upstream (repository commit 49229553967b6050c92d9602eb577bdc48167e91, tag @emotion/styled@11.14.1).
changes: Written for VPM: getRegisteredStyles, registerStyles and insertStyles with the original's behavior, and the EmotionCache, SerializedStyles and RegisteredCache types.

Depends on vemotion-sheet, whose StyleSheet type its declarations use: @emotion/utils imports @emotion/sheet's types without depending on it, so installed on its own (pnpm, isolated installs) its declarations fail to compile (TS2307).
The #is-browser condition chooses browser or server behavior, as in the original's conditional builds.

verification.upstreamSuite: Emotion's 293 tests (hash, weak-memoize, sheet, cache, react, styled) pass with this package in place of the original, in development and production builds.
verification.declarations: scripts/emotion-conformance/types.cjs compiles an application against the declarations with DOM types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
